cross_item_pattern.rule: In a design or purpose item whose stem names a variable to isolate or a condition to test, the key is the only option that changes exactly that stem-named condition, or that holds everything but the stem-named variable constant; every distractor changes a different variable, changes two at once, or names no manipulation. Applied with the passage covered it picks the key on 5 of 5 (chance 25%). Caveat for the coordinator: this is the generic ACT control-of-variables construct, not a brief-specific quirk, so whether it counts as a tell is your call.
